page.layout: One column of running text; in the left margin two marginal notes, "Omnibus]" beside the second paragraph and "A vobis enim]" beside the third. Printed page number 24 at top left, running head at top centre. Catchword "vangelii," at the lower right.

main_text.p: ti; & dictu mirum est, quám multi, quám cito, quantâ fide, quanto zelo converti ad Christum confueverunt. Vide Actorum 3. & alibi. Similiter in primâ illa religionis Christianæ reformatione, quæ fuit Lutheri & aliorum temporibus facta, vis afferebatur regno cælorum, & violenti rapiebant illud, Matth.ii.i2. Sed jam ille zelus & ardor ille multò remissior factus est, ut planè videatur numerus electorum & servandorum paulatim contractior fieri.

Omnibus]Significat, omnes Thessalonicenses omnibus Macedonibus & Achæis exemplaria fuisse, & superiores in fide factos esse. Hoc ad amplificationem gratiæ Thessalonicensium pertinet. multa enim hoc loco congeruntur ad commendationem & amplificationem gratię & fidei eorum.

A vobis enim]Reddit rationem, cur dixerit, eos exemplaria fuisse credentibus, qui erant in Macedonia & Achaia, á promulgato per eos in Macedonia & Achaia Evangelio. Sensus horum verborum videtur esse, quód viatores Thessalonicá profecti, iisque ex Thessalonicensibus, qui in regionibus ipsis vicinis mercaturā exercebant, totidem præcones extiterint fermonis illius & gratiæ, quam ipsi domi jam perceperant. Nam certum est, inter cæteras propagandi Evangelii rationes á Deo ordinatas, hanc unam esse, cúm qui peregré proficiscuntur é regione aliquâ, vel urbe, in qua auditur Evangelium Christi, secum unâ quasi exportant gratiam & fermonem E-

page.notes: Marginal notes "Omnibus]" and "A vobis enim]" are printed in italic with a closing bracket; the bracket is kept as printed. The reference "Matth.ii.i2" is set in small roman numerals and is transcribed as printed; the final numeral is uncertain. Some letters in the scan are faint (for example "Thessalonicá", "mercaturā", "cúm"), but they were read as printed. The line "ti; & dictu" begins mid-paragraph, so the first paragraph is marked as a continuation.
